summary: Fixed unreleased migrations 0012 (index drop/recreate, exact integer foot-to-metre rounding) and 0013 (no concat_ws, which SQLite 3.40 lacks), the label view (metres), and stratum.toml (cp1252 collectors, deferred taxa, TS/SD basis codes). Fresh build passes all checks and a copy of the 1.6.0 database upgrades to the same schema and rows.
